parsed.text: Panel p0 current distributions (some copied from record_time 11 represented_time 12, and a history estimate for n3) are: n0 and n3 uniform over the 4×4 grid; n1 has blue concentrated on the four cells at rows 0–1, columns 2–3 and red on rows 0–1, columns 0–1; n2 is the opposite. Candidate command records for p0 (k0,k1,k2) are conditional (not executed): they differ at n3—k1 leaves n3 uniform while k0 and k2 concentrate probability on the same four-cell peaks. Panel p1 current mirrors p0 for n0–n2 with n3 uniform. Panel p1 candidate records vary at n3: k1 uniform, k0 concentrated on four cells, and k2 concentrates almost all mass to single cells (blue at [1,2], red at [0,1]). Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are hypothetical, not events that have occurred.
